verdict.rationale: MoonPay's MCP server (moonpay-docs-6/27, moonpay-probe-3) only lets AI agents search and retrieve documentation content — it does not enable an agent to actually operate MoonPay's core functions (quoting, buying, selling crypto, KYC) via natural-language commands. All other integration paths (widgets, SDKs, APIs) are traditional code-based, not NL-driven agentic control.
